title: Shopify connector (Beta)
body:
The Shopify connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests e-commerce data such as products, orders, customers, inventory, fulfillments, and discounts from Shopify into Databricks. Authentication uses the Shopify OAuth client credentials grant.

See [Shopify connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/shopify).
